description: Real attributed quotes from Stoics, warriors, athletes, and operators.

quotes.text: You have power over your mind, not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: Waste no more time arguing what a good man should be. Be one.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: If it is not right, do not do it. If it is not true, do not say it.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: Difficulties strengthen the mind, as labor does the body.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: Luck is what happens when preparation meets opportunity.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: It is not what happens to you, but how you react to it that matters.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.text: First say to yourself what you would be. Then do what you have to do.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.text: No man is free who is not master of himself.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.text: The most important conversations you will ever have are the ones you will have with yourself.
quotes.author: David Goggins

quotes.text: Do not stop when you are tired. Stop when you are done.
quotes.author: David Goggins

quotes.text: I fear not the man who has practiced ten thousand kicks once, but I fear the man who has practiced one kick ten thousand times.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.text: Mistakes are always forgivable, if one has the courage to admit them.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.text: Comparison is the thief of joy.
quotes.author: Theodore Roosevelt

quotes.text: Do what you can, with what you have, where you are.
quotes.author: Theodore Roosevelt

quotes.text: In the midst of chaos, there is also opportunity.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.text: Every battle is won before it is ever fought.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.text: The difference between a successful person and others is not a lack of strength, not a lack of knowledge, but rather a lack of will.
quotes.author: Vince Lombardi

quotes.text: I have failed over and over and over again in my life. And that is why I succeed.
quotes.author: Michael Jordan

quotes.text: Some people want it to happen, some wish it would happen, others make it happen.
quotes.author: Michael Jordan

quotes.text: Everybody has a plan until they get punched in the face.
quotes.author: Mike Tyson

quotes.text: I hated every minute of training, but I said do not quit. Suffer now and live the rest of your life as a champion.
quotes.author: Muhammad Ali

quotes.text: It always seems impossible until it is done.
quotes.author: Nelson Mandela

quotes.text: The cave you fear to enter holds the treasure you seek.
quotes.author: Joseph Campbell
